purpose: Single-factor reachable neck-command learning pilot after verified head overtravel; separate from hip/foot repairs and formal reward comparison
sole_between_arm_change: Cap the last two neck-command curriculum amplitudes at the existing joint soft limit around HOME; rewards, action execution, other commands and physics unchanged
restore: Same checkpoint weights, Adam, adaptive rate, observation normalization and curriculum; fresh seed-matched environment/episode/RNG history
evaluation: Last checkpoint only; 1000-frame ONNX parity, unchanged five commands x 32 first episodes x 20 seconds, seed 1001; all head commands zero. Recompute actual head posture/speed, hip posture, signed foot gap, tracking and falls.
acceptance: All original motion criteria and uncrossed feet/no sustained inward-limit posture are still required for stable walking. A single-seed 250-update pilot can identify directional head changes, not prove general repair or authorize long training. Do not promote automatically.
postprocessing_failure_policy: Keep completed learning; repair exports/analysis from saved data without retraining
matched_start: Same parent weights, optimizer, normalization, physical reset and RNG boundary; head command observations differ by the declared range scaling, so first policy actions need not be equal

statistics: per-episode mean bias relative to HOME
head_metrics.aggregation: Report every command and head joint plus paired per-episode differences. No selective best checkpoint or new tuned success threshold.
